label: protocol-test
description: Manually authored parser tests for the trace-v1 wire format (validation/fixtures/protocol/). They exercise the protocol reader/validator: schema, ordering, losslessness, integrity, and fail-closed rejections. They are not game behavior and not reference-runtime oracles.
provenance_rules: Every sample is synthetic and explicitly a protocol-test; any game/loader hashes appearing in them are well-formed placeholders, never actual metadata.
These samples must never be used to validate game correctness or as RNG oracles.
Reference fixtures may be added only after a real pinned-game capture is reviewed and verified (see docs/validation/capture-guide.md).
Protocol samples may contain well-formed synthetic metadata only with this explicit protocol-test provenance.

protocol/valid.jsonl.notes: header + initial + two steps (play_card strike-1 -> cultist-1, then end_turn) + end(victory); full fingerprint chain; the reference reader must report exactly 2 steps.

protocol/rng_numeric_instead_of_hex.json.notes: header rng.seed_words entry is a JSON number instead of a 16-digit hex string.

protocol/missing_header.jsonl.notes: document starts at the initial record.

protocol/missing_end.jsonl.notes: header + initial + one step, then EOF: no end record.

protocol/duplicate_step.jsonl.notes: two step records both use index 0.

protocol/nonfinite_quantity.jsonl.notes: a step expected state contains the NaN literal.

protocol/truncated.jsonl.notes: final line is cut mid-string and lacks its terminating newline.

protocol/unsupported_state_field.jsonl.notes: initial state carries a potions field (unsupported mechanic) which must be rejected, never dropped.

protocol/tampered_fingerprint.jsonl.notes: step 0 carries a fingerprint that is not the SHA-256 of the preceding line.
